messages:
clare.marketing: Quick heatcheck — we're launching a compact slab on the pricing page next week. Need copy for CTA + two tiny FAQ snippets. keeping it short: 1) primary CTA text 2) secondary contact path 3) 2-line FAQ answers. Can we iterate live?

nora_growth: Love it. Two CTA variants: "Estimate cost" (self-serve) and "Talk to sales" (warm routing). We should gate the latter behind a small lead form. A/B split 50/50. :bar_chart:

mika_prod: For the micro-FAQ, propose: Q1: "How do committed slabs work?" A1: "Choose a monthly commit for discounted token rates; you can change at renewals." Q2: "Can I mix models?" A2: "Yes — routing chooses best price/latency per request." Short enough?

aj_sales: +1 on the two CTAs. For "Talk to sales", please route enterprise-size leads (company>50 seats or monthly spend > $3k) straight to AE queue. Others go to nurture. Also include a subtle badge "SLA available" for Dedicated plan.

sam_engineering: Tracking notes: add `pricing_cta_variant` in dataLayer, fire `pricing_lead` event on form submit with `estimated_monthly_tokens` and `company_size` fields. We'll wire to Growth's funnel. Also confirm the calculator returns the same unit labels as the SKU page.

clare.marketing: Draft CTAs: Variant A (self-serve): "Estimate your cost" — smaller, clear. Variant B (sales): "Speak with an expert" — for conversions. Draft FAQ microcopy matches Mika's but shorten first answer: "Pick a monthly commit for discounts; change at renewal." Any objections?

nora_growth: Slight tweak to Variant A: "Estimate cost now" (adds urgency). For experiment naming: `pricing_compact_slab_cta_v1`

aj_sales: For routing, can we add a hidden field `mrr_estimate` pushed from the calculator so we pre-qualify?

sam_engineering: We can. I'll add `mrr_estimate` to the payload. Also please include a small debounce on form to avoid duplicates.

deploy-bot: AB test created: pricing_compact_slab_cta_v1 — 50/50 split ready. Tracking flags: pricing_cta_variant, pricing_lead.

clare.marketing: Timeline: finalize copy by EOD today, QA with Sam tomorrow morning, roll to 10% on staging Wednesday, full ramp Thursday. Ping me in thread when copy is finalized. :sparkles: 

mika_prod: Copy approved from product POV. Tiny ask: add one line in FAQ: "Do you keep my data?" -> "Customer data used for billing only; content not retained by default."

clare.marketing: Adding that. Final copy below — please shout if anything blocks: 1) Variant A CTA: "Estimate cost now" 2) Variant B CTA: "Speak with an expert" 3) Micro-FAQ lines: - "How do committed slabs work?" -> "Pick a monthly commit for discounts; change at renewal." - "Can I mix models?" -> "Yes — routing selects best mix for cost & latency." - "Do you keep my data?" -> "Only used for billing; content not retained by default."

aj_sales: Looks good. Please ensure the sales form includes `company_size` and `mrr_estimate` in the hidden fields.

sam_engineering: I'll QA tags tomorrow AM. No blockers on my side.

clare.marketing: Perfect — thanks everyone. I'll post the creative and the small screenshot for the staging QA shortly. :rocket:
